name: Free Online SSL Certificate Inspector & HTTPS Checker - ATools
description: Free online SSL certificate inspector & HTTPS checker: In-depth X.509 certificate parsing (issuer/validity/SAN), domain HTTPS reachability tests, and direct access to authoritative audit reports.
seoDescription: Free online SSL certificate inspector and HTTPS reachability checker. Parse .crt, .cer, and .pem SSL/TLS certificates client-side in seconds, extracting issuer, days remaining, SAN domains, and public keys. Also tests domain HTTPS connectivity and redirect statuses, providing direct links to SSL Labs and MySSL reports. Pure client-side processing without uploading files.

ui.note: Note: In-browser sandboxes cannot directly intercept raw TLS handshake certificates from external sites. This tool provides: ① Online domain HTTPS reachability & redirect testing with direct links to authoritative reports; ② Instant, local client-side parsing of SSL certificate files (.crt/.cer/.pem) for detailed fields and expiration countdowns.
